summary: Layout attestation: the committed 256x32 array GDS stream (layout/sram_256x32/sram_256x32_array.gds), bound by path and content hash. The regeneration claim records the generator command and the hash of a fresh scratch-directory regeneration, minted by signoff/regenerate.sh; the grader compares that hash to the bound stream and echoes the generator without running it. Not proven by this envelope: that the layout is DRC- or LVS-clean (items 3 and 4 cite those reports) or that the bitcell and periphery GDS are current.
